sources.author: Proteus
patch_list: Allow screenshots & screen recording
Removes FLAG_SECURE and secure-surface flags from Meesho's windows so screenshots and screen recording work. Payment screens may still capture black.
Block analytics & tracking
No-ops AppsFlyer, Mixpanel, Facebook App Events, Firebase Analytics, GMS AppMeasurement and Crashlytics logging in Meesho. Push notifications and login/payments keep working.
Bypass forced update
Neutralizes Play Core's update-availability checks so Meesho does not block usage on a newer version. Running an outdated build may break.
Change package name

Installs Meesho beside the official app by changing the package, permission names, provider authorities and launcher label. Payments (JusPay), Truecaller/Otpless login, Google sign-in and Shield anti-fraud may not work on the clone.
Disable in-app popup upsells
Disables Meesho's InAppPopupActivity so full-screen promo/upsell popups never render. May break a flow that legitimately routes through it — verify first.
Disable reels autoplay
Stops Meesho's reels from autoplaying muted previews. Opening a reel still plays normally. Heuristic — verify ExoPlayer anchors against the real APK.
Hide sponsored listings & ad slots

Hides 'Ad'-labelled sponsored products in Meesho's search and feed by forcing app-side boolean ad gates to false. Heuristic — verify anchors against the real APK. Server still serves ads; only client rendering is affected.
Lock exported share-in / bank-link activities
Makes Meesho's exported SharedTextRedirectionActivity and MyBankActivity non-exported. Internal navigation still works; external apps/links can no longer start them.
Packaging toolkit (signature, install source, MicroG)
Applies the shared signature, install-source and GmsCore/MicroG patches to Meesho in one step. Does not bypass Play Integrity, Shield or fix payments.
Prefer external browser over Custom Tabs
Removes Meesho's Custom Tabs service query so browser links can fall back to the normal external browser. No effect if Meesho launches Custom Tabs directly.
Remove dangerous permissions (keep storage & SMS)

Removes contacts, phone-state, microphone, location, screen-capture detection and advertising-ID permissions from Meesho's manifest. Storage and SMS permissions are kept. Truecaller login, support voice calls and location-based address ent…
Stop pull-notification alarms (keep push)
Disables Meesho's alarm-based pull-notification receivers so the app is not periodically woken to fetch marketing notifications. FCM push keeps working.

sources.label: Debakar
sources.author: Debakar
patch_list: Install alongside original

Installs the patched app under its own package name and app name, so the original app stays installed. Push notifications and some sign-in options may not work in the separate copy. Disable it to replace the original app instead.
Sort by number of ratings
Adds Sort (off / most rated / top rated), 4★+, Hide ads and a 'Ranked' list to Meesho catalog, search and collection feeds. The ranked list orders every page the app has loaded.
